_comment: Decisions APS-Conecta made. Extends _base.json; lists concatenate, scalars override.
_comment_licence: ADR 0010 supersedes 0007: AGPL-3.0-or-later across every repo. The apps link @nextcloud/vue (AGPL), so the obligation is inherited, not chosen.
_comment_language: Repo docs English. Only the org profile/README.md is bilingual ES/EN.
_comment_language_exempt: Deliberately Spanish: a doc is exempt when its READER is Spanish-speaking (the staff-facing conventions, the clinical guide, the staff manuals) or when Spanish is its SUBJECT (the statutes and the legal obligations — the law as published, and material about Spanish domain terms). Entries match by path suffix. gestion's USER_MANUAL.md is Spanish under a recorded deferral, not an exemption — it stays a finding until its translation lands. Everything else in Spanish is a finding.
_comment_versions: Components whose documented version must match compose.yaml.
_comment_leak: Added to the universal set — Spanish wording and our own infrastructure notes.
_comment_boxes: Checklist wording in our SECURITY.md, mapped to the setting that settles it.
_comment_single_tenant: Wording that presumes one clinic where the software is multi-site: sites/<slug>/site.sh, a 2655-row DEIS register, and gestion ADR-0013 (the establishment is instance configuration; moved out of epidemiologia 2026-08-09). 'CESFAM' as a clinic TYPE is correct and must not match.
_comment_code_owners: Who reviews. One account today; every commit in every repository is his and no other account has access.
_comment_root: Where the clones live is machine-local, not policy: see config.json.
